Olympus now has 30+ full guilds with over 30,000 members

facts.t: Olympus is a network of dozens of guilds sharing one name and tabard, built on the ALLIANCE side of the PvP ruleset during the beta.
Size: 30,000+ (his own count, Sep 23), 40,000+ per the Olympus addon census by week two.
Game Rant (Sep 25) called Olympus Alliance-based and reported Sodapoppin plays Horde to avoid Olympus chat.
PARAPHRASE (translated from Polish coverage): on stream he described a plan for Olympus to monopolize rare crafting recipes so outsiders must join for free crafting ('treat it like a tariff').
Says he has a secret 'master plan' if Blizzard disbands Olympus (early Oct stream).

asmon.verdict: Alliance + PvP ruleset. If the BBCC wants quiet Alliance PvP questing, expect a sea of Olympus tabards. Horde PvP or the Normal ruleset avoids the zerg.
